title: Refuge from cowardice and a feeble old age
cue: The refuge Sa'd taught his sons as the Prophet ﷺ said it after prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-jubn, wa'a'oodhu bika an uradda ilaa ardhalil-'umur, wa'a'oodhu bika min fitnatid-dunyaa, wa'a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabr
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from cowardice. I seek refuge with You from being returned to the most feeble age. I seek refuge with You from the trials of this world. And I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 2822: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/4472

usage.evidence: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas taught his sons these words as a teacher teaches children to write, saying the Prophet ﷺ sought refuge with them after the prayer (al-Bukhari 2822).
